ابتغيتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَغَيْتُنَّ (ibtaḡaytunna) /ib.ta.ɣaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اُبْتُغِيتُنَّ (ubtuḡītunna) /ub.tu.ɣiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
